title: Luxury three bedroom townhouse near airport
description:
✨ Luxury King Suite | Private Garage

Sleep in comfort, enjoy your privacy, and stay close to the best of Nashville!

Welcome to your beautifully appointed luxury king bed suite, thoughtfully designed for a relaxing and convenient stay. Enjoy a new, exceptionally comfortable memory foam mattress, perfect for recharging after a day of exploring Nashville.

The private suites feature attached bathrooms; a spacious walk-in shower; the private attached two-car garage makes parking safe &convenient.

The space
Great high quality three-story building with everything new. Plenty of coffee to start your day. The king bed suite and double queen suite are on the third floor with private laundry room at hallway. The third bedroom is on the first floor. Living room, kitchen, and porch are on the second floor. New queen size sofa sleeper and air mattress are in living room area. Extra beddings are available for sofa and air mattress beds upon request. Additional fee will be added ($40 each). The half bathroom is on the second floor.

Guest access
Two car garage at first floor. Additional parking space is available along the subdivision entrance lane.

Other things to note
The refrigerator/filter are new and ice/water are consumable.
